greeting.text: Oh, thank the light, someone who looks capable. Please, I need help. My farm's overrun.

responses.text: I cleared those rats for you.

rat_problem.text: Rats! Big ones, mean ones. Nested in my grain cellar. I'll lose the whole harvest if someone doesn't clear them.

rat_details.text: Dozens, at least. I hear them scratching all night. Some are big as dogs. It ain't natural, I tell you.

responses.text: That sounds like more than I can handle.

unnatural_rats.text: Dunno. Ever since that strange fog rolled through last autumn, critters have been... wrong. Bigger. Angrier.

fog_memory.text: Came from the forest. Smelled like rot and copper. Animals went mad for days after. The old elf might know more.

responses.text: Let me handle those rats first.

mention_elara.text: Elara, the alchemist. Keeps to her shop near the chapel. Strange woman, but wise. Been here longer than anyone.

responses.text: I'll speak with her. But first, the rats.

aldric_too_old.text: These old bones? I'd be rat food before I got down the cellar stairs. Please. I'll pay what I can.

payment_offer.text: Fifty coin and whatever herbs I've got dried. It's not much, but it's honest pay for honest work.

quest_accepted.text: Bless you. Cellar's round the back of the barn. Watch your step down there, the stairs are rotten.

responses.text: I'll be back when it's done.

farm_backstory.text: Three generations, my family worked this land. Was peaceful once. Before the goblins, before the fog.

things_changed.text: Two winters ago. Goblin raids started small. Now they burn whole fields. Hearthholm's barely holding on.

responses.text: Someone should do something about those goblins.

aldric_hope.text: Rowan's Guild is trying. But there aren't enough swords and too many monsters. Maybe you'll tip the balance.

responses.text: I intend to. Now, about those rats?

rats_cleared.text: You did it? Oh, bless you, child! Here, take this. It's all I've got, but you've saved my livelihood.

responses.text: Any other work you need done?

post_quest_chat.text: You remind me of my son. He joined Rowan's Guild years back. Good lad. Be careful out there like he wasn't.

son_story.text: Went into Thornwood chasing goblins. Never came back. Rowan still blames himself. Don't tell him I said that.

post_quest_work.text: Nothing right now, but if you're headed to town, tell Thorgrim I've got iron scraps from the old plow.

end.text: Please, if you change your mind... I'm running out of time and grain both.

end_grateful.text: The light watch over you, friend. You're a good soul in dark times.
